parameters.query:
SELECT c.id,c.ats_candidate_id,c.name,c.phone,c.email,c.skills,c.location AS candidate_location,c.absence_rate,c.late_rate,c.no_reply_count,c.reliability_score,c.last30d_missions,
(COALESCE(c.reliability_score,50)*0.40+(100-COALESCE(c.absence_rate,20)*100)*0.30+(100-COALESCE(c.late_rate,20)*100)*0.20+(100-LEAST(c.no_reply_count*10,100))*0.10) AS ranking_score
FROM candidates c
WHERE c.opt_out=FALSE AND '{{ $json.skill_required }}'=ANY(c.skills)
AND c.id NOT IN (SELECT ats_candidate_id FROM missions WHERE mission_date='{{ $json.mission_date }}' AND status NOT IN ('DECLINED','COMPLETED_ABSENT'))
AND c.absence_rate<0.30 ORDER BY ranking_score DESC LIMIT 5;

(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM missions m2 WHERE m2.ats_candidate_id=c.ats_candidate_id AND m2.created_at>=NOW()-INTERVAL '30 days') AS recent_mission_count,r.email AS recruiter_email,r.slack_user_id AS recruiter_slack
FROM candidates c JOIN missions m ON m.id={{ $json.mission_id }} LEFT JOIN recruiters r ON r.id=m.recruiter_id WHERE c.id={{ $json.candidate_id }} LIMIT 1;
